description: Source code for Qhull's QhullFacetList class, which manages linked facets in Qhull's computational geometry algorithms.

classes.name: QhullFacetList
classes.description: A class representing a linked list of Qhull facets, with methods for conversion, containment, and counting.

methods.name: toStdVector
methods.description: Converts the list of facets to a standard vector.

methods.name: vertices_toStdVector
methods.description: Converts the vertices of the facets to a standard vector.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific facet is contained in the list.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of facets in the list.

methods.name: count (overload)
methods.description: Returns the number of occurrences of a specific facet.
